question: Which Viceroy of British India organised the statistical survey of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mayo**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Viceroy who organized the statistical survey of India was **Lord Mayo**.
 
• Lord Mayo served as the Viceroy of India from 1869 to 1872.
 
• He is credited with initiating the first comprehensive census of India, which laid the groundwork for future statistical surveys and data collection in the country.
 
• The census aimed to gather detailed information on the population, economic conditions, and various social aspects of India during British rule.
 
• His efforts in organizing the statistical survey were crucial for administrative and policy-making purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Mayo** was also known for his efforts in improving the financial administration of India and promoting public works.
 
• He was assassinated in 1872 by Sher Ali Afridi, a convict at the Andaman Islands, making him the only Viceroy of India to be murdered while in office.
 
• Lord Mayo's tenure is often remembered for his significant contributions to the administrative and infrastructural development of British India.
